Vitalik: Crypto Exchanges Must Prioritize Survival Over Competition in the Next Two Years

Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin told Moneycontrol that amid a wave of major exchange hacks, the crypto industry's priority over the next two years should be survival rather than competition. He said recent major attacks have increasingly targeted user interfaces and centralized components rather than smart contracts, urging exchanges and custodians to adopt a more defensive approach.
